subject: ZenPath renewal + expansion: competitive performance claim and term anchoring
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@zenpath.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@zenpath.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion — request for performance confirmation and pricing

Hi Tessa,

Quick note — ZenPath's renewal (Sept) is coming up and we're evaluating expansion for our search and recommendations workload. We ran an internal benchmark with another vendor (CloudEdge) and they claim a 30% cost advantage at our 16k qps profile using their quantized model variant.

Before we start a formal bake-off, can Redwood confirm:
- realistic latency at 16k qps (p99, 95) for our typical payload (see attached sample traces)
- whether model pinning + prefix caching will preserve latency for sustained bursts
- any portfolio-level discounts or capacity accelerator options for an expansion to 2x current throughput

Attachments: zenpath_benchmark_request_July2027.csv (sample traces and token distributions)

We love Redwood's reliability so far but finance is pressing for hard numbers and a playbook if we proceed to a formal bake-off. Happy to jump on a call this week.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Director of Platform Engineering
ZenPath
From: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@zenpath.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — request for performance confirmation and pricing

Emma — thanks for the context and the traces. Noted the CloudEdge claim; we see that often where model variants and sequence-length assumptions differ.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben will run a workload-aligned proof with your sample traces (we'll mirror the token distribution and 95/99 tail). ETA for a first-pass report: 6 business days.
2) We'll produce a short TCO comparison that normalizes for quantization accuracy differences and tail-latency.
3) Priyom will draft a proposal with a capacity-accelerator option (6-month uplift credits + price anchor) we can attach to the renewal to make an apples-to-apples decision.

Can you confirm the target window for the bake-off (we recommend a 72-hour steady-state validation at production throughput if possible)? Also looping Priyom for commercial alignment.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@zenpath.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — workload plan + required artifacts

Emma / Tessa — attaching our runbook and a short checklist.

Action items we need from ZenPath to mirror the workload precisely:
- production sample traces (you provided a good extract)
- canonical model version(s) currently used in prod (weights/config)
- a short tokenization script if custom
- preferred time window to run steady-state (we prefer a weekend to simulate burst flattening)

We will:
- run a short calibration across our quantized variants (int8/ql4) and a float baseline
- publish p50/p95/p99, cost-per-1k-tokens, and exact CPU/GPU utilization metrics per run
- include a short appendix comparing decoding quality (sample outputs) for each variant so you can spot regression risk

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_benchmark_runbook.txt (text/plain)], [Attachment: benchmark-cap-checklist.md (text/markdown)]

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@zenpath.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@zenpath.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — workload plan + required artifacts

Thanks Ben — attached is our full traces export and the CloudEdge claim summary (they shared high-level run results). Note CloudEdge ran a quantized int8 variant and also used a shorter decoding window for p99 measurement, which may explain some differences.

Attachments: zenpath_benchmark_request_July2027.csv (provided earlier), cloudedge_claim_summary.pdf (vendor PDF they shared)

One more note from procurement: they want a commercial lever that guarantees unit-cost for the next 12 months if we commit to expanded throughput — not just credits. Happy to review whatever Priyom proposes.

—Emma
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@zenpath.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — commercial proposal and performance guardrails

Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround. High-level commercial proposal (draft):

1) Term anchor: 12-month price lock on per-token unit rates for any committed capacity up to 2x current throughput (applies from renewal effective date).
2) Capacity Accelerator: 3 months of uplift credits that cover 50% of the incremental throughput cost during onboarding/bake-off.
3) Performance SLOs: p95 < 120ms and p99 < 280ms for your stated payload distribution during the steady-state window. If we miss the SLO in the final validation, we'll provide an extra month of credits + a rollback option to the prior tier while we remediate.
4) Model pinning + prefix caching included at no extra cost for the committed term.
5) If a bake-off shows a >20% cost delta (CloudEdge advantage remaining after normalizing for decoding window and quantization), we will offer a one-time signing credit to bridge 50% of the delta for the first quarter while we work on optimizations.

Included a short mutual action plan that maps responsibilities, data handoffs, and a suggested weekend for the validation (Fri evening -> Mon morning steady-state).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_zenpath.xlsx (MMP), redwood_benchmark_report_zenpath_July2027.pdf (placeholder — we'll attach after Ben's run)

If that looks reasonable, we can lock dates and Ben will deliver the final report by EOD next Tuesday. Marissa (VP of Sales) is looped for approval on the signing credit clause.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@zenpath.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@zenpath.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — commercial proposal and performance guardrails

Priyom / Tessa — this looks fair and moves the conversation forward. A few clarifications from procurement:
- please put the price-lock language in an amendment we can circulate to legal (we need exact metric definitions and audit rights)
- the signing credit needs a clear measurement window and acceptance criteria (we can sign off on the steady-state p95/p99 run results)

We'll schedule the validation for the weekend you suggested. If Redwood can deliver the p95/p99 targets on the July 16-18 run, procurement is comfortable with the 12-month commitment and the Accelerator credits.

I'll upload the traces to the Drive link you provided and share access to our test cluster account. Looking forward to Ben's report.

Best,
Emma Li
Director of Platform Engineering
ZenPath
[Attachment stub: cloudedge_claim_summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
